cfg.title: Disease lifepaths
cfg.sub: Papers carrying disease tags dip sharply from May 2024 to July 2024 (14 in June against about 291 in a normal month), which looks like a collection gap. Here those 3 months are filled from each disease’s own rate in the months around the gap, and every snapshot is refit. Dashed rings mark diseases whose fit-rule phase differs from the original run; nothing before May 2024 changes. Color by switches to the wave groups from the paper: terms grouped by how their publication volume moved (four count-based groups, built on the gap-filled counts) or by the shape of their lifepath (three archetypes, built on the original fits).
